budget_guard.mechanism: pre-call upper bound (conservative input hard bound + max_tokens completion cap), checked before every request; the run aborts BEFORE a call if it would cross the cap, so realised spend can never overshoot
budget_guard.runner_gate: future live runner must refuse by default and require an explicit --allow-paid-run flag plus an approved plan hash; no live runner is created in this offline phase

request_contract.response_format: identical cee_review_decision_v1 strict json_schema for both providers

sample.retries: none on HTTP 200; INVALID/AMBIGUOUS is scored, not retried; only a transport/5xx error may be retried once and is logged
sample.selection: full frozen 22-fixture set, fixed before any CEE result; no post-hoc filtering

statistics_plan.interpretation: convergence on fixed bundles vs E1 divergence => acquisition/policy; persistent divergence => interpretation; CEE and E1 scores are never pooled
statistics_plan.language: preliminary/exploratory; wide CIs expected at 22 cells / 10 clusters / class sizes 7-6-9
statistics_plan.paired_contrast: per-bundle paired appropriateness; between-model Delta issue-cluster bootstrap CI (seed=7, n_boot=10000) mirroring ev1_paired._cluster_bootstrap; descriptive exact McNemar flagged low-power
statistics_plan.per_model: DA overall and per evidence class (parseable denominator), always-NEED baseline, error-type counts; all-requests denominator also shown
